newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Van Miert has strong doubts about Boeing deal.
newsitem.headline: EU's Van Miert has strong doubts about Boeing deal.

text.p: BRUSSELS, AMay 13 (reuter) - European Union Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert expressed serious doubts about the legality under European competition rules of the Boeing/McDonnell Douglas merger and said he expected the companies to offer formal remedies to his worries.

"As a consenquence of our strong doubts, we have decided to initiate an in-depth scrutiny into this merger file... because we expressed very serious reservations as to the compatibility of the proposed merger with the European rules on competition policy," he said in a statement in Tuesday.
